description: Code quality, security, and accessibility improvements from comprehensive codebase audit — credential security hardening, query optimization, WebSocket cleanup, WCAG accessibility, error handling, and configuration fixes

userStories.title: Credential model security hardening
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the Credential struct to never leak sensitive values in logs or debug output, and credential deletion checks to propagate errors properly.
acceptanceCriteria: Remove `Debug` from the derive macro on `Credential` struct in `database/src/models/credential.rs`

Implement manual `std::fmt::Debug` for `Credential` that prints `value: "[REDACTED]"` instead of actual credential content — all other fields printed normally using `f.debug_struct("Credential").field(...).finish()`

In `server/src/routes/api/credentials.rs`, replace `.unwrap_or(false)` on the `credential_in_use()` call with proper error propagation using `?` or `.map_err()` that returns a 500 Internal Server Error
Add comment on `get_credential()` in `database/src/queries/credentials.rs` documenting that it automatically decrypts credential values via `decrypt_credential()`
`cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings` passes
`cargo test --workspace` passes
userStories.notes: Files: `database/src/models/credential.rs` (Credential struct derives Debug which prints SSH keys/passwords to logs), `server/src/routes/api/credentials.rs` (credential_in_use().unwrap_or(false) silently allows deletion if DB query fails — database error should become 500, not 'safe to delete'). The manual Debug impl pattern: `impl fmt::Debug for Credential { fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result { f.debug_struct("Credential").field("id", &self.id).field("name", &self.name).field("value", &"[REDACTED]").field("credential_type", &self.credential_type)...finish() } }`. Keep Serialize/Deserialize/Clone derives unchanged. Read the struct to see all fields.

userStories.title: Replace dynamic SQL string building in servers.rs with QueryBuilder
userStories.description: As a developer, I want server update queries to use sqlx::QueryBuilder instead of manual string concatenation, so the code is safer and easier to maintain.
acceptanceCriteria: CONTEXT7 RESEARCH: Before implementing, use the Context7 MCP tool to query sqlx docs for 'QueryBuilder push push_bind conditional update SQLite'. Use the latest patterns found.
Replace the manual `String::push_str()` + `Vec<String>` parameter pattern in the `update_server()` function in `database/src/queries/servers.rs` with `sqlx::QueryBuilder`
Use `.push()` for SQL fragments and `.push_bind()` for all parameter values
Conditional field updates preserved: only SET fields that are `Some(...)` in the input struct
Remove the manual `Vec<String>` params accumulator and the for-loop that binds them one by one
Function behavior unchanged — same fields updated conditionally, same return type
`cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings` passes
`cargo test --workspace` passes
userStories.notes: File: `database/src/queries/servers.rs` (update_server function). Current anti-pattern: builds UPDATE with `String::from("UPDATE servers SET updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP")` then `query.push_str(", name = ?")` for each present field, accumulates values in `Vec<String>`, then binds them in a loop. QueryBuilder pattern: `let mut qb: QueryBuilder<Sqlite> = QueryBuilder::new("UPDATE servers SET updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP"); if let Some(name) = &input.name { qb.push(", name = ").push_bind(name.clone()); }` ... `qb.push(" WHERE id = ").push_bind(id); qb.build().execute(pool).await?;`. Import: `use sqlx::QueryBuilder;`. QueryBuilder handles parameter numbering automatically.

userStories.title: Skip unnecessary credential decryption in list operations
userStories.description: As a developer, I want credential listing to skip expensive decryption for values that will be redacted anyway, reducing CPU overhead.
acceptanceCriteria: Modify `list_credentials()` in `database/src/queries/credentials.rs` to NOT call `decrypt_credential()` on each credential
Instead, set each credential's `value` field to `"[REDACTED]"` directly in the list function
Ensure `get_credential()` (single credential fetch by ID) still decrypts the value for actual use in SSH connections and terminal operations
Verify API routes that list credentials still work correctly — check `server/src/routes/api/credentials.rs` list endpoint
Verify terminal routes that need actual values still use `get_credential()` — check `server/src/routes/terminal.rs` and `terminal_pty.rs`
`cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings` passes
`cargo test --workspace` passes
userStories.notes: File: `database/src/queries/credentials.rs` (list_credentials function). Current behavior: fetches all credentials then calls `decrypt_credential()` on each one, but the API endpoint immediately redacts the values anyway. The fix: skip `decrypt_credential()` in the list and set `value = "[REDACTED]".to_string()`. Keep `get_credential()` (single fetch) unchanged — it's used by terminal.rs and terminal_pty.rs to get actual SSH keys/passwords for connections.

userStories.title: Modal focus trap implementation
userStories.description: As a keyboard user, I want focus to stay trapped inside open modals so I can navigate modal content without accidentally interacting with the page behind it.
acceptanceCriteria: CONTEXT7 RESEARCH: Before implementing, use the Context7 MCP tool to query Svelte 5 docs for '$effect cleanup keydown event listener focus trap modal'. Use the latest patterns found.
Add focus trap logic to `ui/src/lib/components/ui/Modal.svelte` that activates when the modal is open
On modal open: save `document.activeElement` as the previously focused element, then focus the first focusable element inside the modal content
Tab from last focusable element wraps to first focusable element inside the modal
Shift+Tab from first focusable element wraps to last focusable element inside the modal
Escape key closes the modal via the `onClose` prop (check if already implemented — if so, keep existing logic)
When modal closes: restore focus to the previously saved element
Use `$effect` with a cleanup function to add/remove the keydown event listener
Focusable elements query: `button:not([disabled]), [href], input:not([disabled]), select:not([disabled]), textarea:not([disabled]), [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])`
`cd ui && npm run check` passes
`cd ui && npm run build` passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: File: `ui/src/lib/components/ui/Modal.svelte`. Read the full component first to understand current structure. The modal likely has an `open` prop and `onClose` callback. The focus trap should: (1) on open, save activeElement and query all focusable elements inside the modal container div, (2) add keydown listener for Tab/Shift+Tab/Escape, (3) on close, remove listener and restore focus. Use `$effect(() => { if (open) { ... setup ... return () => { ... cleanup ... } } })` pattern.
